locations.name: ASYNC Briefing Room
locations.short_description: A controlled room for assignment review.

locations.name: Equipment Staging
locations.short_description: The team's issued stores are laid out for inspection.

landmarks.name: staging lockers
landmarks.observation: Issued stores remain in the marked staging lockers.
landmarks.inspection: The lockers contain only the equipment assigned to this operation.

locations.name: Threshold Approach
locations.short_description: A controlled access route leading to the Threshold room.

locations.name: Threshold Room
locations.short_description: The staffed boundary between the facility and the Complex-side entry.

landmarks.name: Threshold apparatus
landmarks.observation: The controlled Threshold apparatus occupies the far wall.
landmarks.inspection: Status lamps show the recorded crossing route ready for use.

locations.name: Threshold-Side Entry
locations.short_description: The first controlled position on the Complex side of the Threshold.

environment.lighting: mixed Threshold spill and fluorescent light

locations.name: Utility Room
locations.short_description: A bare utility room under steady fluorescent light.

locations.name: Columned Corridor
locations.short_description: A west-running corridor divided by square columns.

environment.sound: the fixture hum carries between the columns

landmarks.name: square columns
landmarks.observation: Square columns break the westward sightline into regular intervals.
landmarks.inspection: The columns are plain, evenly spaced, and show ordinary surface wear.

locations.name: Open Passage
locations.short_description: An open passage slopes away from the utility room.

landmarks.name: descending grade
landmarks.observation: The floor begins a shallow descent beyond the opening.
landmarks.inspection: The descent continues far enough that its lower end cannot be confirmed from the utility room.

locations.name: Lower-Level Transition
locations.short_description: A descending transition whose lower boundary remains only partly visible.

landmarks.name: lower landing
landmarks.observation: A lower landing is visible beyond the final step.
landmarks.inspection: The landing is clear, but the space beyond it cannot yet be resolved.

locations.name: Level 2 Survey Boundary
locations.short_description: An unresolved lower area beyond the recorded transition.

locations.name: Relay Alcove
locations.short_description: A narrow service recess containing an aging field relay and a sealed supply cache.

landmarks.name: relay bank
landmarks.observation: An aging relay bank occupies the rear wall.
landmarks.inspection: The relay can be isolated or bridged with a compatible field battery.

locations.name: Records Annex
locations.short_description: A low annex where damp paper records remain in shallow wall slots.

environment.surface: level floor with dry paper fragments
environment.sound: the radio carrier drops beneath a steady electrical buzz

landmarks.name: wall record slots
landmarks.observation: Several shallow slots still hold water-marked paper fragments.
landmarks.inspection: One fragment remains stable enough for contained recovery.

locations.name: Service Bypass
locations.short_description: A narrow maintenance line reconnecting the branch routes with the Threshold-side entry.

environment.sound: the main fluorescent hum is muted

landmarks.name: painted guide line
landmarks.observation: A faded painted line points back toward the Threshold side.
landmarks.inspection: The line remains continuous to the return junction despite surface wear.

connections.transition: The team proceeds to equipment staging.
The team leaves staging along the controlled Threshold route.
The team enters the Threshold room together.
The accounted team crosses to the Complex-side entry.
The team advances from the Threshold-side entry into the utility room.
You lead the team west into the columned corridor.
connections.reverse_transition: You lead the team east, returning to the utility room.

connections.transition: The team enters the open passage as its floor begins to descend.
connections.reverse_transition: The team follows the passage back into the utility room.

connections.transition: You take the team down to the lower-level transition.
connections.reverse_transition: The team climbs back into the open passage.

connections.transition: The team crosses the recorded boundary into the unresolved lower area.
The team follows the column line into the relay alcove.
connections.reverse_transition: The team leaves the relay alcove for the columned corridor.

connections.transition: The service line opens onto the bypass walkway.
connections.reverse_transition: The team follows the service line back to the relay alcove.

connections.transition: The team enters the low records annex.
connections.reverse_transition: The team returns from the annex to the open passage.

connections.transition: The annex service door opens onto the bypass.
connections.reverse_transition: The team leaves the bypass through the annex service door.

connections.transition: The painted guide line returns the team to the Threshold-side entry.
connections.reverse_transition: The team enters the marked service bypass from the Threshold side.
